name: 55 dominoes (double-9)
description: 55 dominoes (double-9) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

overview.description: 55 dominoes (double-9) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

history.origins: Double-9 set (55 tiles, 0-0 through 9-9). Block/draw dominoes; same matching rules as double-6. More players or longer games possible.
timeline: Modern era: extended double-nine (55-tile) sets introduced so more players can join than with a double-six set.
history.cultural: Domino games; double-9 common in some regions.

rules.objective: Play all tiles first, or have fewest pips if blocked.
rules.gameplay: Highest double leads. Match to open ends; doubles crosswise. Block: pass if cannot play. Draw: draw from boneyard until playable. Winner scores opponents' pips or lowest if blocked.
keyRules: Match to open ends; doubles crosswise

strategy.basic: Match tiles to open ends; block when ahead; empty hand to win.
strategy.intermediate: Track high tiles and doubles; force draws to hurt opponents.
strategy.advanced: Count suit distribution; plan endgame so you can go out.
tips: Blocking and drawing rules depend on variant (block, draw, etc.).

variations.name: Double-9 block game
variations.description: Standard double-9 block dominoes: players draw a starting hand from the 55-tile set, no further tiles are drawn during play, and the first to empty hand or hold the fewest pips when blocked wins.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Block play uses the same matching rules as the main game; engine-level differences such as initial hand size are not encoded as overrides yet.

variations.name: Double-9 draw game
variations.description: Double-9 draw dominoes: players draw tiles from the boneyard whenever they cannot play to an open end until the stock is exhausted, then pass; the winner is the first out or the lowest pip total when blocked.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Draw variant adds boneyard draw behaviour but reuses the same core engine; explicit draw-from-stock overrides will be modelled later.

variations.name: Partnership double-9
variations.description: Partnership version for four players seated in pairs, using the same double-9 set and block or draw rules but scoring and winning as teams instead of individuals.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Partnership play changes seating and scoring relationships without altering tile-matching rules; dedicated engine overrides are deferred to a focused entry.

scoring.description: Winner scores opponents' pips; or blocked game lowest wins.
scoring.winCondition: Play all tiles first, or have fewest pips if blocked.
